name: Honey Teriyaki Salmon
assumptions: Yield estimated from 1 lb salmon as typical 4-6 oz per serving for an entree; 2 servings is conservative.
Prep + cook time estimated from instructions (mixing glaze ~5 min, pan-frying salmon ~10-15 min total).
Gluten-free is null because soy sauce is typically wheat-containing unless certified gluten-free; no certification mentioned.
Shellfish is null because no explicit shellfish but cross-contamination possible in unstated sauces or processing.
Sake treated as compatible with all listed diets (alcoholic but no animal products).
Sesame listed as both ingredient and potential allergen (true).
No dairy, eggs, tree nuts, peanuts, or milk present.
instructions:
Mix all the ingredients in the Honey Teriyaki Glaze together. Whisk to blend well. Combine the salmon and the Glaze together.

Heat up a skillet on medium-low heat. Add the oil, Pan-fry the salmon on both sides until it’s completely cooked inside and the glaze thickens.

Garnish with sesame and serve immediately.

ingredients.name: Salmon
ingredients.assumptions: Raw salmon fillet, edible portion only; 1 lb = 454 g.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.assumptions: Typical olive oil density; 1 tablespoon = 14 g.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: Standard Japanese-style or low-sodium soy sauce; 1 tbsp ≈ 15 g so 2 tbsp = 30 g.

ingredients.name: Sake
ingredients.assumptions: Typical cooking sake (rice wine); 1 tbsp ≈ 15 g so 2 tbsp = 30 g; carbs from residual sugars.

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed
ingredients.assumptions: Toasted sesame seeds; 1 tbsp ≈ 9 g so 4 tbsp = 36 g.
